# SYNESIS_E118 — Error

## Description

Hierarchy cycle: concept_a -> concept_b -> concept_a.

## Severity

An **error** stops compilation: no JSON, CSV or other export is written until it is fixed. Errors local to an `EXPORT` block are reported as warnings when compiling and stop only that block in `synesis export`.

## Compiler message

```text
The hierarchy has a cycle: concept_a -> concept_b -> concept_a.
  A concept cannot be, directly or indirectly, broader than itself.
```
